_comment: Each garment SVG is generated independently, so it never shares the body's exact framing/scale. transform (scale, tx, ty) is calibrated once per asset by matching the garment's own figure bounding box (full height, horizontal center) against the base body's bounding box in body-solo-front.svg (canvas 1333x2000). Apply as: transform="translate(tx,ty) scale(scale)" on a <g> wrapping the garment's inner paths, layered on top of the body.
